entries.5604bffa8501c686: Based on the basic principle of “Customer-Oriented Manufacturing,” the company develops and promotes section steel processing machines for the building steel frame and can and sheet metal industries and circular saw cutting machines for the automotive-related and steel processing industries as its main products, and states that it will advance development of new products for labor and setup saving, proposal-based sales, and enhancement of maintenance services. In addition, the company is updating its new core business system, introducing ERP and SFA, aiming for operation around June 2027.
entries.5c5063cfa3bdb481: The company operates as a single segment, the Metalworking Machinery Business, and demand for its main section steel processing machines is linked to construction demand for steel structures, logistics warehouses, data centers and others.
